relations.name: registered_primary_outcome
relations.semantics: Registered primary outcome wording from the study registry.
relations.grounding_contract: SOURCE row in study_registry.csv primary_outcome column.
relations.construction_rule: One tuple per registry study from CSV.

relations.name: publication_reported_primary
relations.semantics: Primary outcome wording reported in a publication record.
relations.construction_rule: One tuple per publication with reported_primary.

relations.name: publication_stated_registry_id
relations.semantics: Exact registry identifier string carried by a publication record.
relations.grounding_contract: SOURCE registry_id, trial_registration, or registration fields.
relations.construction_rule: Assert when publication JSON contains a registry id field.

relations.name: dataset_stated_registry_link
relations.semantics: Registry identifier listed on a dataset deposit record.

relations.name: dataset_protocol_code
relations.semantics: Protocol code label on a dataset deposit.
relations.construction_rule: One tuple per dataset with protocol_code.

relations.name: publication_protocol_code
relations.semantics: Local protocol code cited by a publication.

relations.name: dataset_row_count
relations.semantics: Row count on a deposited dataset file.

relations.name: publication_n_analysed
relations.semantics: Analysed sample size reported by a publication.
relations.construction_rule: One integer per publication with n_analysed.

relations.name: dataset_variable
relations.semantics: Variable name and description from a dataset codebook.

relations.name: identity_candidate
relations.semantics: Mechanical same-study candidate link before semantic judgment.
relations.grounding_contract: Exact shared ids, protocol codes, or matching counts.
relations.construction_rule: Emit symmetric candidates from deterministic rules only.

relations.name: outcome_correspondence_candidate
relations.semantics: Registry/publication pair linked by an established or candidate study identity.
relations.construction_rule: Pairs where a publication may report a registry study.

relations.name: study_identity_judgment
relations.semantics: Grounded judgment whether two records refer to the same underlying study.
relations.grounding_contract: Evidence packet in obligations.json and assertion grounding.
relations.construction_rule: Resolve each live identity_candidate or required pair.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Do two records refer to the same underlying study?

relations.name: outcome_correspondence_judgment
relations.semantics: Grounded judgment whether a publication's reported primary corresponds to the registered primary outcome.
relations.grounding_contract: Evidence packet citing registry wording, publication wording, and methods notes.
relations.construction_rule: Resolve each outcome_correspondence_candidate with established publication identity.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Does the reported primary outcome correspond to the registered primary outcome?

relations.name: variable_sufficiency_judgment
relations.semantics: Grounded judgment whether dataset variables suffice to reanalyse the registered primary outcome.
relations.grounding_contract: Codebook variables, registered outcome text, and methods notes.
relations.construction_rule: Judge only when dataset-to-study identity is ACCEPT; otherwise UNRESOLVED or no tuple.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Do represented dataset variables support reanalysis of the registered primary outcome?

relations.name: purpose_a_study
relations.semantics: Purpose A row: registered outcome traceability per study.

relations.name: purpose_b_link
relations.semantics: Purpose B row: cross-source study reconciliation link.
relations.grounding_contract: DERIVATION mapping study_identity_judgment dispositions to epistemic labels.

relations.name: purpose_c_study
relations.semantics: Purpose C row: primary-outcome reanalysis readiness per registry study.
